sloka: कपिराजविमुक्तैस्तैः शैलवर्षैस्तु राक्षसाः।विकीर्णशिरसः पेतुर्निकृत्ता इव पर्वताः ।। ६.९७.१२ ।।
transliteration: kapirājavimuktaistaiḥ śailavarṣaistu rākṣasāḥ।vikīrṇaśirasaḥ peturnikṛttā iva parvatāḥ ।। 6.97.12 ।।

translations.english: Hit by the rocks rained by the Vanara king, the Rakshasas with heads broken and body mutilated had fallen like mountains.
